newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real off 0.08 pct on continued dlr outflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real off 0.08 pct on continued dlr outflows.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.08 percent on continuing dollar outflows to close at 1.0190 to the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday deficit of $95 million.
The daily deficit was mostly due to financial sell operations caused by payments on maturing Eurobonds, dealers said.
They added the market was likely to open nervously Tuesday with maturing Eurobonds continuing to create dollar demand.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0224 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real dropped 0.1 percent to end at 1.029 per greenback, traders said.
